brief_title: Clinical Study for Patients With Hypertension Associated With Dyslipidemia
official_title: Multi-institutional, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Control, Factorial Design, 4-arms, 8 Week Administration, Phase 3 Clinical Study for Patients With Hypertension Associated With Dyslipidemia

primary_outcomes.measure: LDL-C percent change of DWJ1276 from baseline
DBP change of DWJ1276 from baseline

brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of DWJ1276

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult male and female in between ages of 20 and 80 at the time of screening
* Subject who can understand information provided and who can sign written consent voluntarily

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with hypersensitivity to olmesartan and rosuvastatin
* Pregnant or lactating women and fertile women who is not using proper contraceptive method
* Patient with history of drug or alcohol abuse
